note_settlement: Settlement Coherence M1: the bounded settlement rectangle, in TILE CELLS relative to the Town Hall centre cell. Citizens hard-clamp their position inside [hall - half_width_cells, hall + half_width_cells] x [hall - up_cells, hall + down_cells] and only search for work within work_radius_cells. These are movement/AI bounds only — NOT storage capacity (a real storage-building rule owns that later).

mvp_observables.shelter_score: nearby solid blocks around/above Town Hall
mvp_observables.light_score: torches or light sources near Town Hall/shelter zone
mvp_observables.damage_score: Town Hall damage or breached shelter
mvp_observables.threat_score: active enemy or pressure event severity
mvp_observables.population_pressure: population count relative to food/shelter support
